title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

title: Junior Accounts Assistant
description:
Junior Accounts Assistant

Salary: £30-35,000 (Plus study support)

Permanent - Office

About the Role

We are currently supporting a growing organisation with the appointment of a Junior Accounts Assistant to provide financial support across a portfolio of projects. This is a hands-on role that will suit an up and coming finance professional who enjoys working closely with operational and project teams, ensuring project costs and revenues are accurately recorded, financial reporting is maintained, and projects are appropriately controlled from start to finish. You will work closely with Project Managers and operational stakeholders, providing financial insight, resolving queries and helping ensure projects remain financially accurate and well managed.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide day-to-day financial support to Project Managers, responding to queries and resolving project-related financial issues.
- Support the financial reporting and monitoring of newly launched projects.
- Prepare regular labour utilisation reports and analyse labour costs and resource usage.
- Incorporate relevant labour and project cost information into management reporting.
- Prepare and post monthly inventory-related journals across UK and international operations.
- Lead regular financial review meetings with Project Managers and operational stakeholders.
- Investigate and resolve project billing and invoicing queries.
- Review project cost postings to ensure expenditure is accurately coded and allocated.
- Review revenue postings and ensure income is correctly attributed to the relevant projects.
- Support the financial completion and closure of projects, ensuring all outstanding financial activity has been addressed.
- Prepare and post work-in-progress journals and associated adjustments.
- Prepare and post project-related accruals and prepayments.
- Maintain project budgets, forecasts and estimates within financial reporting systems.
- Update project financial information to reflect variations, changes in scope and additional work.
- Monitor corporate card expenditure, ensuring transactions are accurately recorded and allocated to the appropriate projects.
- Process and allocate employee and business-related expenses against the relevant projects.
- Produce ad-hoc financial analysis, reporting and commentary to support operational and management decision-making.
- Identify discrepancies, investigate variances and work with stakeholders to ensure accurate financial information.

About You

We are looking for a commercially minded finance professional with strong attention to detail and the confidence to work directly with non-finance stakeholders.

You will ideally have experience of:
- Project accounting, management accounting or a similar finance role.
- Working with project costs, budgets, revenue and work-in-progress.
- Preparing and posting journals, accruals and prepayments.
- Analysing labour utilisation and project performance.
- Supporting project managers and operational teams with financial information.
- Investigating financial discrepancies and resolving queries.
- Working with large volumes of financial data and producing clear reporting.
- Using Excel and financial/accounting systems to analyse and maintain financial information.

The successful candidate will be organised, analytical and proactive, with the ability to manage competing priorities and build effective relationships with stakeholders across the business.

The Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional looking to take ownership of a varied project-focused remit within a growing organisation. You will have the opportunity to work closely with operational leadership, gain broad exposure to project finance and play an important role in improving the accuracy, visibility and control of project financial performance.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Sullivan Way Surgery is looking to recruit an experienced, enthusiastic and reliable Medical Receptionist to join our busy GP practice in Wigan. We are seeking someone with previous GP practice reception experience who understands the demands of primary care and can provide a professional, efficient and compassionate service to our patients. The successful candidate will be confident using EMIS Web and Docman, able to work independently, manage competing priorities and remain calm and professional in a busy environment. They will understand the importance of confidentiality, accuracy, teamwork and delivering excellent patient care. This is an opportunity to join a dedicated practice team where the reception service plays a vital role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the surgery. Main duties will include: Welcoming patients and visitors and dealing with enquiries in a friendly, professional and confidential manner. Answering telephone calls, managing patient queries and directing enquiries appropriately. Booking, amending and cancelling appointments in accordance with practice procedures. Using EMIS Web confidently to access and update patient records accurately. Using Docman to manage incoming clinical correspondence and related administrative tasks. Processing patient requests, messages, prescriptions and documents in line with practice protocols. Supporting the GP-led appointment navigation process and ensuring patient requests are recorded accurately. Maintaining accurate patient information, including demographic details and relevant administrative coding. Recognising urgent or potentially concerning requests and escalating them appropriately to the clinical team. Supporting the wider administrative team with referrals, scanning, workflow management and other general practice duties. Maintaining strict patient confidentiality and complying with information governance, safeguarding and data protection requirements. The role requires flexibility, excellent organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workload while maintaining a high standard of patient service. Sullivan Way Surgery is seeking an experienced Medical Receptionist to join our busy GP practice in Wigan. The postholder will provide a professional, efficient and welcoming reception and administrative service to patients, clinicians and colleagues, supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. Key Responsibilities Act as the first point of contact for patients, dealing with telephone and face-to-face enquiries professionally and sensitively. Book and manage appointments in line with practice procedures and the GP-led appointment navigation process. Use EMIS Web and Docman confidently to access patient records, process correspondence and complete administrative tasks. Record patient requests and messages accurately and ensure these are directed to the appropriate person. Support referrals, prescription-related enquiries, scanning, workflow management and general administrative duties. Maintain accurate patient records and uphold strict confidentiality and information governance requirements. Recognise urgent concerns and escalate appropriately to the clinical team. Work effectively as part of the wider practice team, managing competing priorities and supporting colleagues when required. Comply with practice policies, safeguarding procedures, health and safety requirements and mandatory training.
